title.en: Unit 6 Notes — Laterally Restrained Beam and Purlin
title.gu: યુનિટ 6 Notes — Laterally Restrained Beam અને Purlin

items.syllabus_item: 6.1 laterally restrained main secondary beams rolled sections

body.en:
Main beams carry loads from secondary beams or slabs to columns or walls; secondary beams transfer their loads to main beams. Rolled I-sections are efficient in major-axis bending because flanges provide much of the moment resistance and the web transfers much of the shear. A laterally restrained beam has adequate lateral restraint to its compression flange throughout the relevant length; the restraint itself and its attachment must be designed. Simply assuming the slab or purlins provide restraint is not enough.

Classify flange and web using IS 800:2007 Table 2 width/thickness limits for the actual stress and steel grade: plastic, compact, semi-compact or slender. Section class controls permissible resistance calculation. Use verified steel tables for area, mass, I, elastic modulus Ze and plastic modulus Zp; these are properties of the section about a specified axis.
body.gu:
Main beams, secondary beams અથવા slabs નો load columns અથવા walls સુધી પહોંચાડે છે; secondary beams પોતાનો load main beams સુધી પહોંચાડે છે. Rolled I-sections major-axis bending માટે કાર્યક્ષમ છે: flanges moment resistance નો મોટો ભાગ અને web shear નો મોટો ભાગ આપે છે. Laterally restrained beam માં સંબંધિત સમગ્ર length પર compression flange ને યોગ્ય lateral restraint હોય છે; restraint અને attachment નું પણ design જરૂરી છે. Slab અથવા purlins restraint આપે જ છે એવી ધારણા પૂરતી નથી.

Actual stress અને steel grade માટે IS 800:2007 Table 2 ના width/thickness limits થી flange અને web ને plastic, compact, semi-compact અથવા slender classify કરો. Section class પ્રમાણે resistance ની ગણતરી નક્કી થાય છે. Area, mass, I, elastic modulus Ze અને plastic modulus Zp verified steel tables માંથી લો; આ ચોક્કસ axis વિશેની section properties છે.

items.syllabus_item: 6.2 bending shear plastic modulus beam strength

body.en:
For a laterally supported plastic or compact section in bending, the design bending strength is generally Md = βb Zp fy/γm0, subject to applicable caps including 1.2 Ze fy/γm0; βb = 1 for plastic/compact sections. For semi-compact sections use elastic section modulus and code provisions; slender sections require effective-section provisions. Yield strengths can depend on plate thickness. Design shear strength without shear buckling is Vd = Av fy/(√3 γm0), using the appropriate shear area Av.

Check applied factored bending and shear at critical sections. High shear can reduce bending resistance; IS 800 clause 9.2.2 gives the applicable interaction when shear exceeds the specified threshold (commonly 0.6 Vd). Thin webs may require shear buckling provisions instead of the simple yielding formula. Also check concentrated loads and support reactions for web bearing, buckling and crippling, and provide stiffeners as designed.
body.gu:
Laterally supported plastic અથવા compact section માટે સામાન્ય રીતે design bending strength Md = βb Zp fy/γm0 છે, લાગુ caps સહિત 1.2 Ze fy/γm0 ની મર્યાદા હેઠળ; plastic/compact માટે βb = 1 છે. Semi-compact section માટે elastic section modulus તથા code provisions અને slender section માટે effective-section provisions લાગુ છે. Yield strength plate thickness પ્રમાણે બદલાઈ શકે છે. Shear buckling વગર design shear strength Vd = Av fy/(√3 γm0) છે; યોગ્ય shear area Av લો.

Critical sections પર factored bending અને shear તપાસો. વધુ shear થી bending resistance ઘટી શકે; IS 800 clause 9.2.2 માં નિર્દિષ્ટ threshold (સામાન્ય રીતે 0.6 Vd) થી વધુ shear માટે interaction છે. Thin webs માટે સરળ yielding formula ને બદલે shear buckling provisions જરૂરી થઈ શકે. Concentrated loads અને support reactions માટે web bearing, buckling અને crippling તપાસી design મુજબ stiffeners આપો.

items.syllabus_item: 6.3 beam deflection shear lag web crippling

body.en:
Check service deflection using appropriate unfactored service loads, actual support conditions and second moment of area. For a simply supported prismatic beam under full-span uniformly distributed load, δmax = 5wL⁴/(384EI). Compare against the relevant IS 800 serviceability limit and project requirements; the limit is not universal. Consider vibration, cracking of finishes and ponding where relevant.

Shear lag is non-uniform longitudinal stress across a wide flange where parts are remote from the web; use effective width when applicable. Web crippling or local bearing failure can occur near a heavy concentrated load or support. Check actual bearing length, load dispersion, web slenderness and stiffening provisions; shear lag and web crippling are distinct phenomena.
body.gu:
Appropriate unfactored service loads, actual support conditions અને second moment of area વડે service deflection તપાસો. Simply supported prismatic beam પર સંપૂર્ણ span માં uniformly distributed load માટે δmax = 5wL⁴/(384EI) છે. લાગુ IS 800 serviceability limit અને project requirements સાથે સરખાવો; limit સર્વત્ર એકસરખી નથી. જરૂરી હોય ત્યાં vibration, finishes માં cracking અને ponding પણ ધ્યાનમાં લો.

Shear lag માં wide flange ના web થી દૂરના ભાગે longitudinal stress અસમાન હોય છે; લાગુ હોય ત્યારે effective width લો. ભારે concentrated load અથવા support પાસે web crippling કે local bearing failure થઈ શકે. Actual bearing length, load dispersion, web slenderness અને stiffening provisions તપાસો; shear lag અને web crippling અલગ phenomena છે.

body.en:
Purlins span between trusses and support roof sheeting; angles, channels and other sections may be used. Determine dead, roof imposed and wind loads with correct tributary width, orientation, combinations and support conditions. Resolve vertical load into components normal and parallel to the roof: w⊥ = w cos θ and w∥ = w sin θ. Wind may act approximately normal to the roof but must use actual pressure coefficients and tributary area. Sag rods and sheeting may restrain only if their stiffness, connections and load path are adequate.

Find bending about both relevant principal axes and apply the applicable IS 800 biaxial interaction, section classification, shear and stability requirements. If the axes are not aligned with roof directions, resolve forces and moments correctly about actual principal axes. Check service deflection in relevant directions, uplift reversal and connections. A simplified linear interaction is a screening assumption only unless the appropriate code rule supports it.
body.gu:
Purlins, trusses વચ્ચે span થઈ roof sheeting ને support આપે છે; angles, channels અને અન્ય sections વપરાય છે. યોગ્ય tributary width, orientation, combinations અને supports સાથે dead, roof imposed અને wind loads શોધો. Vertical load ને roof ના normal અને parallel components માં વહેંચો: w⊥ = w cos θ અને w∥ = w sin θ. Wind લગભગ roof ને normal હોઈ શકે, પણ actual pressure coefficients અને tributary area લો. Sag rods અને sheeting માત્ર ત્યારે restraint આપે જ્યારે તેમની stiffness, connections અને load path પૂરતા હોય.

બંને સંબંધિત principal axes પર bending શોધી લાગુ IS 800 biaxial interaction, section classification, shear અને stability requirements લાગુ કરો. Axes roof directions સાથે ન મળે તો actual principal axes પર forces અને moments યોગ્ય રીતે resolve કરો. સંબંધિત directions માં service deflection, uplift reversal અને connections તપાસો. યોગ્ય code rule સમર્થન ન આપે ત્યાં સુધી simplified linear interaction ફક્ત screening assumption છે.

title.en: Numerical 6.1 — Beam strength in bending and shear
title.gu: Numerical 6.1 — Beam ની bending અને shear strength

body.en:
Given: A fully laterally restrained compact beam has Zp = 350000 mm³, Ze = 320000 mm³ and Av = 3000 mm². Take fy = 250 MPa and γm0 = 1.10. Assume no shear buckling and low shear. Find Md and Vd.

Step 1. Calculate plastic bending resistance and cap.

Zp fy / γm0 = 350000 × 250 / 1.10Zp fy / γm0 ≈ 79.55 kN m1.2 Ze fy / γm0 = 1.2 × 320000 × 250 / 1.101.2 Ze fy / γm0 ≈ 87.27 kN mMd = min(79.55, 87.27)Md = 79.55 kN m

Step 2. Calculate shear resistance.

Vd = Av fy / (√3 γm0)Vd = 3000 × 250 / (√3 × 1.10)Vd ≈ 393.65 kN

Final answer:

Md ≈ 79.55 kN m and Vd ≈ 393.65 kN; web and service checks remain.
body.gu:
આપેલ છે: સંપૂર્ણ laterally restrained compact beam માટે Zp = 350000 mm³, Ze = 320000 mm³ અને Av = 3000 mm² છે. fy = 250 MPa અને γm0 = 1.10 લો. Shear buckling નથી અને shear ઓછી છે તેમ ધારો. Md અને Vd શોધો.

Step 1. Plastic bending resistance અને cap ગણો.

Zp fy / γm0 = 350000 × 250 / 1.10Zp fy / γm0 ≈ 79.55 kN m1.2 Ze fy / γm0 = 1.2 × 320000 × 250 / 1.101.2 Ze fy / γm0 ≈ 87.27 kN mMd = min(79.55, 87.27)Md = 79.55 kN m

Step 2. Shear resistance ગણો.

Vd = Av fy / (√3 γm0)Vd = 3000 × 250 / (√3 × 1.10)Vd ≈ 393.65 kN

અંતિમ જવાબ:

Md ≈ 79.55 kN m અને Vd ≈ 393.65 kN; web તથા service checks બાકી છે.

title.en: Numerical 6.2 — Service deflection of a beam

body.en:
Given: A simply supported beam has span 4 m, service UDL 20 kN/m, E = 200000 N/mm² and I = 30 × 10⁶ mm⁴. Find deflection and compare only with an assumed project limit L/300.

Step 1. Convert to consistent units.

L = 4000 mmw = 20 N/mm

Step 2. Calculate maximum deflection.

δmax = 5wL⁴ / (384EI)δmax = 5 × 20 × 4000⁴ / (384 × 200000 × 30 × 10⁶)δmax ≈ 11.11 mm

Step 3. Calculate the assumed limit.

Limit = L / 300Limit = 4000 / 300Limit ≈ 13.33 mm

Final answer:

11.11 mm is less than 13.33 mm, so this assumed service-deflection criterion passes.
body.gu:
આપેલ છે: Simply supported beam માટે span 4 m, service UDL 20 kN/m, E = 200000 N/mm² અને I = 30 × 10⁶ mm⁴ છે. Deflection શોધી ફક્ત ધારેલ project limit L/300 સાથે સરખાવો.

Step 1. સુસંગત units માં ફેરવો.

L = 4000 mmw = 20 N/mm

Step 2. Maximum deflection ગણો.

δmax = 5wL⁴ / (384EI)δmax = 5 × 20 × 4000⁴ / (384 × 200000 × 30 × 10⁶)δmax ≈ 11.11 mm

Step 3. ધારેલ limit ગણો.

Limit = L / 300Limit = 4000 / 300Limit ≈ 13.33 mm

અંતિમ જવાબ:

11.11 mm, 13.33 mm કરતાં ઓછું છે, તેથી આ ધારેલ service-deflection criterion સંતોષાય છે.

body.en:
Given: A simply supported purlin spans 5 m on a 20° roof. Vertical UDL is 1.20 kN/m along the purlin. Assume roof-normal and roof-parallel directions align with the relevant section axes. Calculate the two component loads and UDL moments.

Step 1. Resolve the vertical line load.

w⊥ = w cos θw⊥ = 1.20 cos 20°w⊥ ≈ 1.128 kN/mw∥ = w sin θw∥ = 1.20 sin 20°w∥ ≈ 0.410 kN/m

Step 2. Calculate peak moments from each component.

M⊥ = w⊥ L² / 8M⊥ = 1.12763 × 5² / 8M⊥ ≈ 3.52 kN mM∥ = w∥ L² / 8M∥ = 0.41042 × 5² / 8M∥ ≈ 1.28 kN m

Final answer:

Component moments ≈ 3.52 and 1.28 kN m; full design also requires interactions, wind, stability and service checks.
body.gu:
આપેલ છે: Simply supported purlin 20° roof પર 5 m span કરે છે. Purlin દીઠ vertical UDL 1.20 kN/m છે. Roof-normal અને roof-parallel directions સંબંધિત section axes સાથે મેળ ખાતી ધારો. બંને component loads અને UDL moments શોધો.

Step 1. Vertical line load ના components શોધો.

w⊥ = w cos θw⊥ = 1.20 cos 20°w⊥ ≈ 1.128 kN/mw∥ = w sin θw∥ = 1.20 sin 20°w∥ ≈ 0.410 kN/m

Step 2. દરેક component ના peak moments ગણો.

M⊥ = w⊥ L² / 8M⊥ = 1.12763 × 5² / 8M⊥ ≈ 3.52 kN mM∥ = w∥ L² / 8M∥ = 0.41042 × 5² / 8M∥ ≈ 1.28 kN m

અંતિમ જવાબ:

Component moments ≈ 3.52 અને 1.28 kN m; સંપૂર્ણ design માટે interactions, wind, stability અને service checks પણ જરૂરી છે.

q.en: What is a laterally restrained beam?

a.en: A beam with adequate lateral restraint of its compression flange.
a.gu: Compression flange ને યોગ્ય lateral restraint ધરાવતો beam.

a.en: A beam receiving loads from secondary members.
a.gu: Secondary members થી loads લેતો beam.

a.en: A beam transferring load to main beams.
a.gu: Main beams સુધી load પહોંચાડતો beam.

a.en: Plastic section modulus about a specified axis.
a.gu: નિર્દિષ્ટ axis વિશે plastic section modulus.

a.en: Elastic section modulus about a specified axis.
a.gu: નિર્દિષ્ટ axis વિશે elastic section modulus.

q.en: Where is beam shear mainly resisted?
q.gu: Beam shear મુખ્યત્વે ક્યાં resist થાય છે?

a.en: By the web of an I-section.
Local failure near concentrated loading or supports.
a.gu: Concentrated loading અથવા supports નજીક local failure.

a.en: Non-uniform longitudinal stress across a wide flange.
a.gu: Wide flange પર અસમાન longitudinal stress.

a.en: A roof member supporting sheeting between trusses.
a.gu: Trusses વચ્ચે sheeting ને support આપતો roof member.

q.en: Why does a purlin bend biaxially?
q.gu: Purlin માં biaxial bending કેમ થાય?

a.en: Loads can have components about two axes.
a.gu: Loads ના બે axes વિશે components હોઈ શકે.

a.en: It can reverse forces and load combinations.
a.gu: તે forces અને load combinations ને ઉલટાવી શકે છે.
